answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 39806 Country: India Title: Whether the purity (paki) is essential for bride and bridegroom at the time of nikah Question: Whether the purity (paki) is essential for bride and bridegroom at the time of nikah? Answer ID: 39806 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1379/1101/B=1433) The main thing in nikah is ijab-o-qubul (the exchange of proper words of nikah). If Muslim girl gave permission of nikah happily and then the Qazi performed the nikah and the boy accepted it then this nikah was valid as per the Shariah whether they are pure or impure; in each case nikah was valid and effective. However, nikah is an Islamic ritual along with being a contract, hence if nikah is done in the state of purity and wudhu it is far better and a source of virtue and blessing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
